verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email — Tijorat+
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.body: To finish signing up for Tijorat+, enter the code below or press the button.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password — Tijorat+
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset the password of your Tijorat+ account. Enter the code below or press the button to set a new password.

initCode.subject: Activate your account — Tijorat+
initCode.heading: Activate your account
initCode.body: A Tijorat+ account was created for you. Enter the code below or press the button to set a password and sign in.

invite.subject: You are invited to {app}
invite.heading: You are invited to {app}
invite.body: Press the button to accept the invitation, set a password and sign in.

otp.subject: Your sign-in code — Tijorat+
otp.heading: Your sign-in code
otp.body: Enter this code to sign in to Tijorat+. Do not share it with anyone.

passkeyLink.subject: Sign in with fingerprint or Face ID — Tijorat+
passkeyLink.heading: Turn on passwordless sign-in
passkeyLink.body: Press the button on the device you want to sign in with, then confirm with your fingerprint, Face ID or PIN.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed — Tijorat+
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password of your Tijorat+ account was just changed. If this was not you, reset your password on the sign-in page right away.

domainClaimed.subject: Your username was changed — Tijorat+
domainClaimed.heading: Your username was changed
domainClaimed.body: The domain {domain} now belongs to an organization, so your username was changed to {username}. Sign in and set a new email.
